RANCH.gloss: farm consisting of a large tract of land along with facilities needed to raise livestock
RANCH.definition: Farm consisting of a large tract of land along with facilities needed to raise livestock (especially cattle).

CHURN.gloss: stir vigorously in order to make butter
CHURN.definition: Stir (cream) vigorously in order to make butter.

ARCH.gloss: a curved shape in the vertical plane that spans an opening
ARCH.definition: A curved shape in the vertical plane that spans an opening.

YUAN.gloss: the basic unit of money in China
YUAN.definition: The basic unit of money in China.

ANY.gloss: one or some or every or all without specification
ANY.definition: One or some or every or all without specification.
ANY.example: Give me any peaches you don't want.

RUN.gloss: move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time
RUN.definition: Move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time.
RUN.example: Don't run--you'll be out of breath.

CAN.gloss: preserve in a can or tin
CAN.definition: Preserve in a can or tin.
CAN.example: Tinned foods are not very tasty.

CAR.gloss: a motor vehicle with four wheels
CAR.definition: A motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.
CAR.example: He needs a car to get to work.

RAY.definition: A column of light (as from a beacon).

CRY.definition: A loud utterance; often in protest or opposition.
CRY.example: The speaker was interrupted by loud cries from the rear of the audience.

ARC.gloss: electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field
ARC.definition: Electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field.

HAY.gloss: grass mowed and cured for use as fodder
HAY.definition: Grass mowed and cured for use as fodder.

YARN.gloss: the act of giving an account describing incidents or a course of events
YARN.definition: The act of giving an account describing incidents or a course of events.
